g.text: CampusClaw HTTP Asynchronous Run Acceptance Proposal
validate session_id, key, and strict request body
load live Session and authorize createRun
current model, thinking, history attachments, active pointer
batch resolve, authorize, and mark referenced
for the complete ordered attachment set
resolve current model and input policy
validate historical plus new attachment context
active pointer, idempotency result, dispatch task)
persist Run events, Messages, and terminal RunRecord
clear active pointer and complete dispatch task
Only a committed acceptance consumes the idempotency key.
All pre-acceptance failures can retry with the same key.
There is no cross-service XA transaction.
A referenced attachment mark may remain conservatively after a local failure.
The HTTP connection may close after 202 without aborting the Run.
GetRun, Run Events, and History expose progress and terminal state.
